timing_reconstruction.method: Separate linear interpolation of raw joint_states and base_feedback motor measurements at their bag receipt timestamps

paired_window_mean_timing.method: linear interpolation of matched bag-window means at action-start times
paired_window_mean_timing.limitation: window-close timestamps represent window means; interpolation is approximate, not original hardware commands

timing_reconstruction.start_and_end: Same sample times and endpoint as the 10 ms window-mean control
timing_reconstruction.limitation: Bag receipt timestamps are not hardware acquisition times; these are measured positions, not original hardware commands
